summary: This TypeScript module provides React hooks and utilities to fetch Bluesky social media engagement data (likes, reposts, comments) for blog articles. It manages caching of post lookups in session storage, resolves Bluesky record keys from article metadata or by searching an author's feed history, and aggregates engagement statistics including person identities and their interaction types.

explanations.170: In private browsing mode, sessionStorage throws an error; we silently ignore it since the lookup still works without caching.
